## 2026-10-21 (bonus: standard-KPI condition + management rights — rides PU-2026-11)

- **Joshua (10/21):** "lets make it more broad, so it could be any standard KPI thats not being hit. Lets update everything and make sure it goes in the NEW policy ACK cadence."
- **Rule (from the December 2026 bonus month):** a bonus is earned only if the store meets every standard KPI in force on the 1st (every measurable standard in the P&P, Handbook, store scorecard or a signed Monthly Policy Update) plus the bonus goals; one employee's own documented violation affects only that employee; CEO approves every bonus (approval = conditions met, not a second test); a store/position/company program can be suspended for a legitimate business reason by written notice, for months that begin after the notice; earned bonuses are always paid; bonuses count in the OT regular rate. Legal basis: Va. Code 40.1-29 (earned bonus = wages, treble damages), 29 CFR 778.211 (formula bonus is nondiscretionary).
- **`Bonus Program/bonus_rules.json`** + `management_rights` block (effective 2026-12). NEW `Bonus Program/management_actions.json` (withhold/suspend entries; empty). **`bin/bonus_engine.py`** additive `load_management_actions()` — store-wide or per-employee $0 lines with the KPI/notice/approver note; incomplete or back-dated suspensions HOLD the run. Regression: Sept 2026 close re-run in a copy = $5,391.96 (unchanged); synthetic suspend/withhold/back-date tests pass. **`bin/render_policy.py`** renders the rights from the rules file; `BONUS_POLICY_2026-08.md` / `HANDBOOK_01.08_2026-08.md` regenerated (also fixes the stale 1.5%/3% miss rates → 2%/4%). Backups `*.bak-20261021-kpirights`.
- **Manuals revised in place (published 11/5):** Employee Handbook v2026.8 "Bonus Pay" + What's New; P&P v2026.9 §01.08 + What's New. PDFs re-rendered. Backups `Human Resources/_archive/*.bak-20261021-kpirights`.

Fix in `cloudcover_check.py`: (a) a Playwright `page.on("response")` capture collects the SPA's OWN responses to those two endpoints while the zones page loads, so the browser sends exactly what the dashboard sends; (b) if either is missing, the call is replayed with `fetch()` INSIDE the page context using the SPA's captured request headers; (c) if the API still yields nothing, zones come from the dashboard DOM (the SKILL's own extractor, `DOM_JS`) — streaming + now playing. `--diag` now logs capture counts/header names, each store's Google Home volume + URL, and saves the devices-page text to `fleet/test_output/cloudcover_render/home-<store>.txt` only when no volume was found. Renders 2–5 (jobs `20261020-0952-clockin-northwest-render`, `-1016-clockin-render3`, `-1013-clockin-render4`, `-1015-clockin-render5`) each exposed one more timing/navigation defect, all fixed: the person on page 2 could not be opened (→ the table's "Search team members" box, polled up to 12 s, else reload at page 1 and page forward); the Review table took > 20 s to paint once and three timesheets were skipped (→ `open_review()` waits 45 s on the ROW status selector — the Legend matches the bare one — with a Time-tracking → "Review" fallback); a person's timesheet page also shows a status dot so `on_review()` thought it was still on the table (→ URL check, `/timesheets/` excluded); and **render 3 read an EMPTY People table on a slow load, fell through to the Departments page, built a one-entry garbage roster `{'Social Media': 'Roanoke'}`, CACHED it over the good one and rendered a post listing "Social Media" as the only employee** — a live run would have posted that. - **Why:** Joshua was asked to sign in to CloudCover three times (10/14, 10/15, 10/16) and each native browser check had grown its own Chrome profile (pw-cloudcover, pw-gusto, pw-northwest) plus its own copy of the launcher / prefs helpers. Goal set today: he signs in ONCE, in ONE window, and never again for the same site — with proof, without him, that a session cookie set in that window survives a normal quit and is readable by the scripts' Playwright context.
- **ROOT CAUSE (proven, host jobs `20261019T1025-vp-profile-proof` + `T1030-vp-profile-diag`):** Chrome keeps session cookies (every "logged in" cookie with no expiry) across a restart ONLY when its startup setting is "Continue where you left off" (`session.restore_on_startup = 1`). Every helper so far wrote that key into `Default/Preferences` — but it is a TRACKED (MAC-protected) pref that Chrome reads from `Default/Secure Preferences`; the copy in Preferences is ignored and stripped on quit. So the setting was never in effect on any profile: the sign-in cookie WAS written to `Default/Cookies` at quit (`is_persistent=0` row, read straight from the SQLite file) and DELETED by Chrome at the next launch. Not the keychain (persistent cookies such as `__cf_bm` always came back), not the quit path. Control: forcing `exit_type=Crashed` made the cookie reappear (Chrome's crash-recovery rule), confirming it was on disk all along. cloudcover_check.py also never called any prefs helper at all.
- **FIX — `bin/vp_browser.py` (new, the single home for the profile + launch recipe; full recipe + proof log in its docstring):** profile `~/Library/Application Support/valleypawn/pw-vp` (= the former pw-cloudcover directory, renamed by `vp_browser.py migrate`; backup copy `pw-cloudcover.bak-20261019` beside it; pw-gusto / pw-northwest left in place, unused — both were never signed in). `set_startup_pref()` sets "Continue where you left off" the legitimate way, through Chrome's own settings page (`chrome://settings/onStartup` → `chrome.settingsPrivate.setPref`), so Chrome writes the tracked pref + MAC into Secure Preferences itself; `launch()` self-heals (checks Secure Preferences before every launch and re-sets it if ever lost). `prefs()` now only fixes `exit_type=Normal` / `exited_cleanly` (untracked). Launch kwargs unchanged from the 10/18 northwest pattern: installed Chrome (`channel="chrome"`), headed window parked at `-2400,-2400`, `ignore_default_args=["--use-mock-keychain","--enable-automation"]` (real keychain = the two Chromes share one cookie store), AutomationControlled off; `first_page()` closes the tabs Chrome now restores on every launch; `close()` = normal CDP close + wait. `VP_HEADLESS=1` (or the per-script CC_/DC_/GUSTO_/NW_HEADLESS) forces headless for experiments.
- **PROOF (job `20261019T1040-vp-profile-proof2`, no human):** (1a) headed Playwright context on pw-vp, example.com, `document.cookie="vp_persist_test=1; path=/"` (expires -1) + a localStorage key, closed normally → row on disk; (1b) the scripts' exact launch read back `document.cookie 'vp_persist_test=1'` + localStorage `'1'` → **PASS/PASS**. (2a) real quit path: the launcher's exact `open -na "Google Chrome" --args --user-data-dir=pw-vp …` (`vp_signin_front.sh --test`: tabs `httpbin.org` + `postman-echo.com` `/cookies/set?vp_quit_test=1` = server-set SESSION cookies, exactly like a login), 40 s, `vp_signin_close.sh` (one SIGTERM → Chrome records `SessionEnded`, `exited_cleanly=true`) → rows for all three hosts on disk; (2b) the scripts' launch: example.com **PASS/PASS**, httpbin.org `['vp_quit_test=1']`, postman-echo.com `[… 'sails.sid=…', 'vp_quit_test=1']`; a second restart identical. Before the fix (job T1025) both reads were FAIL (localStorage PASS both times — only cookies were affected). Test cookies for example.com/httpbin/postman-echo remain in the profile (harmless).
- **Scripts pointed at the one profile (backups `*.bak-pre-vpprofile-20261019` beside each):** `cloudcover_check.py` (now headed off-screen via vp_browser like the others; was headless with no prefs call), `dress_code_check.py`, `clockin_check.py`, `northwest_check.py` — each `import vp_browser`, `PROFILE = vp_browser.PROFILE`, `vp_browser.launch(p, …)` / `first_page` / `close`, their own `ensure_prefs()` now delegates to `vp_browser.prefs()`, and every sign-in ledger hint says `run bin/vp_signin_front.sh`. All four `--probe` clean on the Mac; syntax-checked.
- **ONE launcher, ONE closer:** `bin/vp_signin_front.sh` quits any copy of the profile, applies prefs + set-startup, then opens ONE Chrome window in front with 4 tabs — `https://tune.cloudcovermusic.com/#/admin/zones`, `https://home.google.com/` (fullcirclepawn@gmail.com), `https://app.gusto.com/` (jdavis@fcfpawn.com, tick "Remember this device for 30 days"), `https://app.northwestregisteredagent.com/`; `--test` = the same `open -na` line with the cookie-test tabs, off-screen (what the proof used). `bin/vp_signin_close.sh` = one TERM, wait, confirm `(Normal|SessionEnded, 1)`. The old names (`cloudcover_signin.sh`, `cloudcover_signin_front.sh`, `cloudcover_signin_close.sh`, `gusto_signin_front.sh`, `northwest_signin_front.sh`, `*_profile_prefs.py`) are kept as one-line wrappers onto the new scripts so every older ledger row / note still works. Allow-list += vp_browser.py, vp_signin_front.sh, vp_signin_close.sh (backup `host_queue_allowlist.txt.bak-pre-vpprofile-20261019`). HUMAN_QUEUE: one new [SIGN-IN] row replaces the separate asks (10/18 Gusto row marked superseded); backup `HUMAN_QUEUE.md.bak-pre-vpprofile-20261019`.
- **Re-run `cloudcover_check.py --render --diag` on pw-vp (job `20261019T1050-cloudcover-render-vp`):** reached `tune.cloudcovermusic.com/#/login` (password field present, cookie domains incl. `.cloudcovermusic.com`, `.home.google.com`) and stopped with the expected sign-in row ("run bin/vp_signin_front.sh …"), rc 4, nothing posted — the old CloudCover session had already been lost to the root cause above, so the one sign-in is still needed, once.
- **What Joshua does, ONCE:** `bin/vp_signin_front.sh` → sign in to the 4 tabs → Cmd-Q. Then one `--render --diag` per check (host queue) and the go-live steps already written in the 10/14 and 10/18 entries.
- **Can still require a repeat sign-in (honest list):** Gusto's "Remember this device" lasts 30 days (a code screen about monthly; the check writes one ledger row when it happens); Google may re-challenge the passkey if it decides the profile is a new device; Northwest's SSO "Remember me" lifetime is unknown until the first signed-in week (10/18 open-risk note stands); CloudCover's own server-side session expiry is unknown (its cookies are session cookies, so they now survive restarts, but the server can still expire them). Any sign-out = one ledger row naming `vp_signin_front.sh`, never a password typed.

## 2026-10-12 (EOM file validation everywhere)

- **Shared checker:** `store_rankings.py` now exposes `structure(path)`, which is `validate()` without the 1st..END window check (needed for any-range exports). ## 2026-10-12 (store-performance bad post fix)

- **What went wrong:** the native 08:45 Monday compile posted #store-performance rankings saying "Loan Balance: all stores at $0.00", with Inventory Balance showing item COUNTS as dollars (CUL $7,536 = 7,536 items; the real figure is $193,735.31). Bad messages: parent `1791809110.099659`, thread reply `1791809110.387019` (C03CGTN3KN1). Joshua needs to delete both (the bot can't).
- **Root cause (checked against the files, not metadata):** `monday_pull.sh` pulled End of Month for 10/1..10/11 (Sunday) at 06:14. Bravo returned a **degenerate export**: right `Reporting Dates` header, but no daily rows, a blank `Total:` row, every Loan Base cell 0, Layaway block 0, and the Inventory Base day columns collapsed (3 values instead of 4). `store_rankings.py` reads by position, so it took inventory index 2 (= month QTY) as dollars and got $0 loans, $0 service charges and $0 layaway. Its only completeness check was "5 files exist, >=500 bytes", so it posted. ceo_week_pull's 07:44 and 07:56 re-pulls of 10/5..10/11 and 10/1..10/11 came back degenerate the same way, so this is Bravo's output for that window that morning, not a one-off file write. The Saturday-stamped 10/1..10/10 set (written Sun 21:43–22:07) is clean. The 10/1..10/4 Monday pull on 10/5 was also clean, so this failure comes and goes. It was not the canonical-copy logic, and the report window was right.
- **Fix (backups `fleet/_backups/{store_rankings,monday_compile}.py.bak-pre-sanity-20261012`):** `store_rankings.py` gets `validate()`: window = 1st..END; Ending Loan and Inventory Base rows have 4 numbers with day == month and > 0; `Total:` row not blank. An invalid set is skipped for the next older valid one (labelled with its own date). If none is valid: HOLD, exit 2, ledger row. Then `sanity()` withholds (exit 2 + ledger row) on any store with $0 loans or $0 inventory, $0 company service charges, or a >50% store or company loan/inventory drop vs the prior week's valid set (end-5..9 days). It tests clean on the 10/11 files (would have withheld on 18 counts) and passes on 10/4 and 10/10. New `--prefix TEXT` puts TEXT before the summary. `monday_compile.py` now tells Joshua's rollup DM that a sanity-gate hold was WITHHELD and why, instead of "held until complete".
- **Corrected post:** rendered on the Mac (identical to sandbox), checked against the 10/10 workbooks (loan, inventory, layaway, Total: row and Sales Revenue (Profit) cells read directly) and against last week (company loans $736,774.98 -> $734,207.88, inventory $724,158.77 -> $735,113.45). Retail, scrap and profit in the 10/10 and 10/11 files are identical, so stores were closed Sunday and 10/10 is the full week. Posted as Goldilocks: `1791821054.326109` ("Corrected: ... Report Period: 2026-10-10"), with the thread broadcast `1791821054.774469`.
- **10/5 post was NOT affected:** its figures match the 10/4 workbooks to the penny (loans $736,774.98).
- **#ffl-transfer-performance 09:54:17 (`1791813257.553729`) was NOT empty.** Raw `conversations.history` (new read-only `vp_slack.py raw <ch> <ts>`, backup `vp_slack.py.bak-pre-rawcmd-20261012`) shows a native Slack table block with all 5 stores plus the Total. The `text` fallback has them too. The Slack connector/reader (and clients that don't support table blocks) show only the title and summary line. Every figure checked against the five 10/1..10/12 nics-transfers CSVs: CUL $260/11, ROA $70/4, WAY $50/2, HAR $25/1, LEX $25/1, total $430/19. No repost.
